name: cniska-gates
description: Saves agents the round trip through agent-gates' gates: after each edit in a repo that commits the no-comments scanner, it scans the edited file against HEAD and tells the agent which comments the edit added and why they are refused, before it commits; and it denies a git command that would skip the gates, such as --no-verify or a core.hooksPath override, naming the gates to fix instead. It never blocks an edit or changes a file.
